question.de: Finde Rajshahi im Westen Bangladeschs am Padma-Fluss.
question.hu: Keresd meg Rádzsáhit Banglades nyugati részén, a Padma folyónál.
question.ro: Găsește Rajshahi în vestul Bangladeshului, pe râul Padma.
question.en: Find Rajshahi in western Bangladesh on the Padma River.

question.de: Finde Rangpur im Norden des Landes.
question.hu: Keresd meg Rangpurt az ország északi részén.
question.ro: Găsește Rangpur în nordul țării.
question.en: Find Rangpur in the north of the country.

question.de: Finde Barisal im südlichen Flussdelta.
question.hu: Keresd meg Barisalt a déli folyódeltában.
question.ro: Găsește Barisal în delta sudică a râurilor.
question.en: Find Barisal in the southern river delta.

question.de: Finde Cox's Bazar an der Küste des Golfs von Bengalen.
question.hu: Keresd meg Cox's Bazart a Bengáli-öböl partján.
question.ro: Găsește Cox's Bazar pe coasta Golfului Bengal.
question.en: Find Cox's Bazar on the coast of the Bay of Bengal.

question.de: Finde Muradpur nördlich von Chittagong nahe der Küste von Sitakunda.
question.hu: Keresd meg Muradpurt Csittagongtól északra, Sitakunda partvidéke közelében.
question.ro: Găsește Muradpur la nord de Chittagong, aproape de coasta Sitakunda.
question.en: Find Muradpur north of Chittagong near the Sitakunda coast.

question.de: Klicke auf die Division Chittagong im Südosten.
question.hu: Kattints a délkeleti Chittagong körzetre.
question.ro: Apasă pe diviziunea Chittagong din sud-est.
question.en: Click the Chittagong Division in the southeast.

question.de: Finde die Division Khulna im Südwesten.
question.hu: Keresd meg a délnyugati Khulna körzetet.
question.ro: Găsește diviziunea Khulna din sud-vest.
question.en: Find Khulna Division in the southwest.

question.de: Klicke auf die Division Rajshahi im Westen.
question.hu: Kattints a nyugati Rajshahi körzetre.
question.ro: Apasă pe diviziunea Rajshahi din vest.
question.en: Click the Rajshahi Division in the west.

question.de: Finde die Division Rangpur im Nordwesten.
question.hu: Keresd meg az északnyugati Rangpur körzetet.
question.ro: Găsește diviziunea Rangpur din nord-vest.
question.en: Find the Rangpur Division in the northwest.

question.de: Klicke auf die Division Barisal im südlichen Delta.
question.hu: Kattints a déli deltában fekvő Barisal körzetre.
question.ro: Apasă pe diviziunea Barisal din delta sudică.
question.en: Click the Barisal Division in the southern delta.
